subtitle: Transforming Education
mission: Our mission is to empower the next generation of digital creators through technology and fun.
history_p1: codear.la was born from observing a gap in formal education: children consumed a lot of technology but understood very little about how it worked. We decided to create a playful and stimulating space where robotics and programming were as accessible as playing with blocks.
history_p2: Today we have a passionate team of engineers, educators, and designers who firmly believe that learning to program is not just for future engineers, but a valuable communication and problem-solving skill for any discipline in life.
value1_bold: Technology as a tool for interaction
value1_text: The real value lies in learning to solve problems using technology, not in being a simple user of it. We believe that technology is only a vehicle that allows us to carry ideas forward and boost work and learning.
value2_text: We understand that machines, no matter how advanced, cannot replace the fundamental role of human interaction. That is why our courses always aim to be face-to-face, mediated by group work, and with a human teacher, not a robot.
value3_text: Our goal is not to replace human interaction with technology, but to enhance it. Technology is at the service of people and not the other way around.
team_subtitle: We are professionals from the software and automation world, passionate educators, who decided to create a different proposal.
member1_desc: Bachelor in Computer Science from UNQ, Professor of Industrial Disciplines from UTN, and Graduate in Advanced Computing from CDAC (India). Alan has worked in the software industry and has been teaching in university and high school environments for more than 10 years.
member2_desc: Automation and Industrial Control Engineer from UNQ, and PhD student at the same institution. Martín has worked in domotics, software development, and automation in numerous companies, and currently dedicates himself to university teaching.
